item.title: UT v. Kouri Richins: Grief Author Murder Trial
item.description: PARK CITY, Utah (Court TV) — A children’s book author faces a potential life sentence if she’s convicted of murdering her husband. Kouri Richins, 35, is charged with aggravated murder, attempted criminal homicide and financial crimes in the death of Eric Richins, who died from a lethal dose of fentanyl in 2022. Prosecutors say Kouri... Read more »

item.title: Testimony Continues in the Kouri Richins Murder Trial
item.description: Day three of Kouri Richins' murder trial begins as she faces accusations of poisoning her husband with a lethal dose of fentanyl and then writing a children's book on grief in the wake of his death. A $1 million reward is offered for Nancy Guthrie's return. (2/25/26)

item.title: Bodycam Footage of Kouri Richins’ Reaction to Husband’s Death
item.description: The jury saw bodycam footage of Kouri Richins' reaction to her husband, Eric Richins' death as she faces a potential life sentence if convicted of murdering her husband. (2/24/26)

item.title: Nancy Guthrie: Why Wouldn’t Authorities Want Large Reward for Information?
item.description: Vinnie Politan Investigates continues to dive deep into Nancy Guthrie's case and asks why law enforcement wouldn't want a large reward which could lead to information regarding her whereabouts or recovery? (2/24/26)

item.title: UT v. Kouri Richins: Key Moments from Day 2
item.description: On day two, police officers, an advanced EMT, and a retired medical examiner took the stand in Kouri Richins' murder trial. According to retired ME, Pamela Ulmer, Eric Richins' autopsy showed that he didn't have a history of any kind of illicit drug use. (2/24/26)

item.title: Colin Gray Calls His Son ‘Such A Good Boy’ in Police Interview
item.description: The jury saw a recorded interview with Colin Gray talking about his son, Colt, who is accused of murdering four people in a shooting at Apalachee High School. Colin is standing trial on charges that he assisted his son by giving him the gun. (2/25/26)

item.description: ADRIAN, Mich. (Court TV/Scripps News Group) — A Michigan man is facing life in prison if convicted in the cold case murder of his once-missing wife. item.title: Colt Gray’s Sister: He Would Talk To Me About School Shooters
item.description: Colin Gray's daughter, Jenni Gray, takes the stand and recalls being worried about Colt Gray having a gun in his room. Jenni, when asked, confirmed that she remembered her brother, Colt talking about school shooters. (2/25/26)
